title: Sikky 350Z/G35 OEM Clutch Line Upgrade Kit
description:
A simple solution for upgrading your Nissan 350Z clutch line.  This bolt on kit will take all the headaches out of plumbing your 350Z clutch system.  Everything needed is included to mate the OEM clutch master cylinder to the CD00x slave cylinder.

Features:

All needed stainless braided lines

Adapter fitting that threads into factory Nissan slave cylinder without modification

All needed hardware and fittings
